author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Thea character trailer for Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, an exploration-based creature collecting RPG developed by Capcom. Players meet Thea, the newest member of the Rangers, who you'll be taking under your wing! Thea's love of Poogies is clear to see, after all, she's always accompanied by her Poogie pal Pookie! Explore more of her character in Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection, launching on March 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Official Thea Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Explore, fight, loot, adapt, survive. Take a look at the release date trailer for Zombiehood, a quirky yet brutal roguelite where every run throws new weapons, gear, artifacts, and rising threats at you. Ammo is scarce, the dead keep evolving, and one smart build can turn a desperate run into total domination. Zombiehood will be available on Steam on April 30, 2026.
title: Zombiehood - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for Angel Engine, a horror surgery sim developed by Black Lantern Collective and HMS Studios. As an intern with no supervision, you’re left in charge of a remote surgery station with little more than video tutorials. As patients are brought to you on an assembly line, you must quickly assess their wounds, choose the right tools, and succeed in distinct mini-games before their anesthesia wears off. Angel Engine is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Angel Engine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the early access launch gameplay trailer for Crystalfall, the upcoming free online action RPG. In Crystalfall, choose your class, grow your arsenal of steampunk weapons, and loot skills with procedural trees. Survive in a world destroyed by a mysterious asteroid and fight hordes of mutants and automatons in search of epic loot. Crystalfall will be available in PC Early Access (Steam and Epic Games Store) on March 20, 2026.
title: Crystalfall - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the demo launch trailer for Kraken Cleaning, a short incremental game where you play as a Kraken who calls upon powers from the abyss to clean the ocean. Clean up the ocean Kraken style, recycle trash into pearls with help from Baby Kraken, and discover ancient powers at the bottom of the abyss. Kraken Cleaning is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Kraken Cleaning  - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ex-SOLDIER 1st Class, seeking the truth, slashes onto the battlefield! Check out the character preview trailer for Cloud Strife in Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy. Cloud Strife joins from Final Fantasy VII. 
Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy is launching March 2026 for iOS and Android and you can pre-register now!
title: Dissidia Duellum Final Fantasy - Official Cloud Strife Trailer
